### 1 — Scene
A grain-based meal with browned chicken-like pieces, cooked green vegetables and a creamy orange-brown coating, alongside a leafy salad.

### 2 — Vessel
A large square dinner plate, partly cropped. Using an equivalent round diameter of **26 cm**, its estimated area is **3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm²**. Food on the neighboring plate is excluded.

### 3 — Items
Visible components appear to be cooked wheat/farro-like grains, chicken pieces, cooked green vegetables, spinach salad with a few carrot shreds, creamy sauce, and a light salad dressing. The exact protein and sauce are uncertain.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy
Area shares below partition the food footprint to avoid counting overlapping ingredients twice. Heights represent each component’s estimated contribution to the pile.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked grains | 25% | 133 × 1.8 = 239 ml | 0.8 | 191 g | 150 | 287 kcal |
| Browned chicken pieces, estimated | 12% | 64 × 1.8 = 115 ml | 0.95 | 109 g | 200 | 218 kcal |
| Cooked green vegetables | 8% | 42 × 1.6 = 67 ml | 0.6 | 40 g | 40 | 16 kcal |
| Spinach and carrot salad | 20% | 106 × 2.5 = 265 ml | 0.15 | 40 g | 25 | 10 kcal |
| Creamy sauce | 3% | 16 × 1.5 = 24 ml | 1.0 | 24 g | 280 | 67 kcal |
| Salad dressing | 1% | 5.3 × 1.1 = 6 ml | 1.0 | 6 g | 450 | 27 kcal |

**Coverage check:** 25 + 12 + 8 + 20 + 3 + 1 = **69% of the plate**, consistent with the substantial uncovered area.

### 8 — Sanity check
The estimate is **410 g and about 625 kcal**. That is plausible for a substantial grain-and-protein pile with a much lighter leafy salad. The sauce composition and protein identification are the main uncertainties.
